name: Ground Turkey Unstuffed Pepper Skillet (Low-Carb)
ingredients_verbatim: 3 medium bell peppers cored and cut into 1-inch pieces
1 pound ground turkey, 93% lean (or ground chicken or lean ground beef)
2 cups cauliflower rice (frozen or fresh; or a combination of cauliflower and broccoli rice)
16 ounces tomato sauce, no salt added (2 cans)
1 cup Monterey Jack cheese shredded (Cheddar, mozzarella, or an Italian cheese blend can be used)
why: Stovetop ground-turkey skillet, no bake. Published 441 cal / 16 g carbs / 31 g protein per serving - inside the 400-650 cal, <=35 g carb band and genuinely high-protein. Structurally low-carb: cauliflower rice base, no rice/pasta/potato/bread/bean. Cheese/olive oil carry it above the 400 floor while balsamic + tomato sauce keep carbs low. Every main ingredient maps to the Omaha board (ground-turkey, bell-peppers, onions, garlic, frozen-cauliflower-florets, tomato-sauce, balsamic-vinegar, shredded-cheese). Batch-scalable to 14 with weigh-and-divide. Not a catalog duplicate (nearest is turkey-stuffed-pepper-soup, a soup). Confidence: HIGH - nutrition and full ingredient list read directly from the source page.
